comment: A knife edge running on into an ordinary edge on the same line (mitcad#1988, port patch 1790). A block 130 x 210 x 40 (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2, Body1) with a bite cut 20 deep from below (Sketch2 F3, the circle of radius 65 about the front edge's midpoint, Extrude2 F4): along the line x = 65, y = 0 the wall meets the bite's cylinder tangentially below z = 20 (a knife edge) and the front face square above it, one tangent chain.

The square edge above rounded with 1 and its tangent chain, the knife edge below: the ball would jump at their vertex on the bite's end plane, from 16.1 into the wedge along the knife edge to the corner along the square edge, which no corner of the kernel joins (it refuses that corner, port patch 1790). The knife edge is rounded first, its end on the bite's end plane, which grows over the tip's section; then the square edge, its end on that plane as at a corner of three edges. Before 1790 a wrong body was kept with a warning that the corner reaches out of the body. Removed: the tip's section 9.277747573 times 20 and the corner's 1 - pi / 4 times 20.
